name: compile-error
purpose: One type error at a known line. Every stage must report an error; a clean result from any tool is a run-health failure (C4).

test.note: The build fails, so no test may be reported as passed or failed.
test.label: confirmed-by:forge@1.8.5

lint.label: to-confirm
lint.note: Solhint parses syntax, not types, so it may lint normally; it must not report the file as clean if it cannot parse it.
